import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]:
    score_feed = inputs["score_feed"]
    score_snapshot = inputs["score_snapshot"]

    # Step 1: STG_CURR = SELECT account_id, AVG(score) AS avg_score
    #          FROM score_feed GROUP BY account_id
    stg_curr = (
        score_feed.groupby("account_id", dropna=False)["score"]
        .mean()
        .reset_index()
        .rename(columns={"score": "avg_score"})
    )

    # Step 2: DELTA computed against the PRE-UPDATE snapshot (before Step 3)
    merged = stg_curr.merge(
        score_snapshot[["account_id", "avg_score"]],
        on="account_id",
        how="left",
        suffixes=("", "_prev"),
    )

    merged["score_delta"] = merged["avg_score"] - merged["avg_score_prev"].fillna(0)

    delta = merged[["account_id", "score_delta"]].copy()

    # Step 3: Replace SCORE_SNAPSHOT with STG_CURR (post-update state)
    new_score_snapshot = stg_curr[["account_id", "avg_score"]].copy()

    return {
        "delta": delta,
        "score_snapshot": new_score_snapshot,
    }
